name: HeliosLite
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Sampled head is unchanged from the prior baseline. Recent recorded work contains share/LSP shell E2E and author-reported local passes plus named inherited CI failures.
concerns: A quiet default branch does not prove the chat is idle.
Inherited repository blockers remain parent obligations, not a reason to end after a narrow PR.

next_actions.title: Reconcile current work and gate ownership
next_actions.work: Return active branch/artifact and classify actual current-head required failures; preserve already merged promotion work.
next_actions.acceptance: Exact blocker IDs, owners and wakeup conditions; no replay of completed work.

next_actions.title: Prove resilient installed execution
next_actions.work: Run matched coding tasks with stream interruption, tool error, child failure, restart and session recovery.
next_actions.acceptance: No duplicate mutation, lost answer or incorrect workspace access; actual output and retry histories retained.

next_actions.title: Deliver and compare the owned binary
next_actions.work: Verify Mac/Windows channels as applicable, update/rollback and upstream identity; compare current fork with KCode/upstream on the same failures.
next_actions.acceptance: Installed and tested artifact are identical; continuity advantage is measured rather than asserted.

ecosystem_contract: Align shared session/tool contracts with peer harness owners without copying their implementations into this fork.
parent_acceptance: A trustworthy installed fork survives the supported long-running workflow and failure modes.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
